name: summarize
title_zh: 播客视频没字幕也能出逐字稿的本地提取器
tagline_zh: 扔个 YouTube 链接或本地音频文件，它先转文字再提炼要点。没字幕的访谈、会议录音、长视频都接得住。
tagline_en: Drop a YouTube link or local audio file—it transcribes first, then distills key points. Handles interviews.
desc_en: Summarize or extract text/transcripts from URLs, podcasts, and local files (great fallback for “transcribe this YouTube/video”).
why_zh: 别的摘要工具只认现成字幕，它自带转录层，把语音先变成文本再总结。
why_en: Other summarizers only read existing captions. This one adds a transcription layer first, turning speech into text before.
limit_zh: 转录质量取决于音频清晰度，嘈杂环境或多人口播会出错；超长视频（>2小时）需分批处理；只输出文本摘要。
limit_en: Transcription accuracy depends on audio clarity—noisy or multi-speaker audio will err. Videos >2h need chunking. Outputs text summaries only; no.
title_en: Local summarizer that transcribes podcasts & videos.
